description: 3D heave of a floating box (X 110) with CFD mesh refinement and subcycling (G 7 1) on 2 ranks: the rank cut goes through the body and the refined box (one patch on each rank there), a second box on rank 1 only (rank 1 has two patches, rank 0 one).
covers: cfd_amr::finest_grid at a patch edge to a patch of another rank (the loads on the patch up to it)
body_loads: the cells around the patches copied from the patches of the same level before the loads
the body forcing on the patches without MPI exchange (solid_forcing_flag_update, geometry_changed): ranks with different numbers of patches
